jobs.tierReason: security review of remote command execution, secret redaction, autopilot spend and merge limits
jobs.prompt: Security and safety review of Phase 10b. Files: tools/remote-exec.mjs (runs a command on a remote host from a JSON request on stdin), tools/journal.mjs (append-only project log with secret redaction), tools/autopilot.mjs (drives runs with no model), tools/project-commands.mjs (journal capture, HANDOFF.md writer, brief/handoff/checkpoint), docs/plans/phase10b-design.md (the rules), and coordination/review/phase10b.diff (the changes to swarm.mjs, install.mjs, goal.mjs, executors.mjs: autopilot deps, remote placement, ssh arguments, updater, Claude hook installer). Check, with evidence from the files: (1) remote-exec: path traversal, symlinks planted in the workspace, files larger than expected, outputs escaping the workspace, the env allowlist, whether the request can run something other than the given absolute command, kill-on-disconnect and orphan handling, anything that could leak a secret into stdout; (2) journal: can a secret survive sanitizeText (api keys, Bearer, KEY=value, urls with credentials, JSON-escaped forms), can an event be forged by a worker or goal text, and the 8192-byte line rule; (3) autopilot: can any path make it merge a PR, deploy, raise a spend cap, pass raises to resume, call a model, or retry without bound; are the deps in swarm.mjs autopilotDeps limited as the design says; (4) project-commands: does journalAfterCommand's capture of printed output or the HANDOFF.md writer (overwrite and HANDOFF.previous.md rules) lose data or write outside the project; (5) the Claude Code Stop hook command and the settings.json merge in install.mjs: injection, clobbering the user's settings; (6) the updater change: can the child installer run attacker-controlled code beyond what update already trusts. Finish with one JSON line: {"status":"complete","summary":"...","findings":[{"file":"...","line":0,"severity":"high|medium|low","issue":"...","fix":"..."}]}.
